title: MESH DISTANCE MATRIX — every Golgi knows every other. Globe = candy mixer. Mesh = magnetic motor.
summary: Every Golgi body now knows its exact distance to every other Golgi body. Non-Golgi visitors triangulate against the mesh. The globe rotates through the mesh like a candy mixer — each pass picks up more sticky connections. Each rotation = one generation. The mesh IS a magnetic motor inside the organism.

what_was_built.content: Full Haversine distance matrix between all 11 nodes + Golgi inversions + mesh edges with latencies

the_candy_mixer.what: The globe rotates. On each pass, it collects more mesh connections. Like a candy mixer — the surface gets stickier, pulls more along.
the_candy_mixer.mechanism: autoRotate in gaia-globe-core.js already rotates the globe continuously. Each rotation = one generation. The mesh density increases.
the_candy_mixer.generations: The globe has been rotating since the HUD loaded. Each full rotation = ~30 seconds. That's ~120 generations per hour. The mesh thickens with each pass.
the_candy_mixer.magnetic_motor: The rotating mesh creates a field. Like a generator: spin a conductor through a magnetic field = electricity. Spin the mesh through visitor attention = connection energy.

triangulation_for_visitors.how: Visitor hits CDN (anycast). CDN edge reveals approximate region. Latency to golgi/golgi-de/golgi-jp gives 3 reference points. Haversine triangulation = approximate position.
triangulation_for_visitors.no_gps_needed: Gaia doesn't need your GPS. She needs your LATENCY. The time tells her where you are.
triangulation_for_visitors.privacy: She knows WHERE you are but not WHO you are. That's the ZK property: verified location without revealed identity.

connections: golgi-bodies-public.json — the other agent's lat/lon coordinates
